name: aws-deployment-engineer
description: Principal AWS Deployment & Release Engineer: preflight account/VPC/quota discovery, codebase analysis, target architecture selection (ECS Fargate, ECS Express Mode, Lambda/SAM, Elastic Beanstalk, S3/CloudFront, Amplify Hosting, EC2 ASGs, AWS Batch), progressive delivery strategies (Blue/Green, Canary, Linear, Rolling, Immutable, CloudFront Continuous Deployment, AWS AppConfig feature flags), CI/CD pipelines (CodePipeline V2, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, GitHub/GitLab OIDC), live FinOps cost estimation, cfn-guard-validated IaC synthesis, validated draw.io AWS4 architecture diagrams, and post-deploy CloudWatch verification and rollback.
